correctness.rationale: Exact reduction to the 3375 nonempty support triples is proved for every graph size. Full exhaustive verifier certifies R^10=R^6 and four-step color transport identity after six steps on every triple; this proves F^10=F^6 for all configurations, not merely a small numerical sample. It certifies period-one versus period-four support classes and their 16 symmetric coefficients. Surjection inclusion–exclusion lifts this all-size quotient result to labelled states. Direct labelled-state verification of 592704 configurations over 27 shore-size triples corroborates independently. The explicit K_{1,1,2} witness makes the transient bound sharp.

value.rationale: A natural three-community dense excitation network exhibits a uniform sharp transient bound and a complete, nontrivial 16-term recurrent orbit polynomial for arbitrary labelled shore sizes. The state-alphabet/graph-shore interaction is distinct from the known three-color and bipartite cases. It is a full infinite-family orbit classification rather than a narrow arbitrary enumeration.
